_doc: Capital Markets chart brand config — Briggs Brand Standards v3 / Northmarq 2024 guide. Single source of truth for CM chart typography, palette, series-ramp order, and color proportions. Loaded by api/_shared/cm-native-chart-injector.js (CM_BRAND). Per-vertical overrides live under `verticals`. This is DATA, not code — a future brand-guide update is a JSON change, not a code change.

_source._provenance_note: The three authoritative source files live in Scott's OneDrive (_WORKFLOW folder) and were NOT reachable from the build sandbox. Values below are taken from Scott's A1-v2 token spec (stated as derived from Briggs v3) and cross-checked against public/reports/cm_brand_tokens.json (reverse-engineered from the gov master workbook theme). ACTION: diff these hexes against the 2024 PDF data-styling page + colorproportions.png and correct any delta here — the PDF + Briggs v3 win. Log deltas in this block.

_typeface_note: Set to Futura PT per marketing chart-formatting feedback (2026-08, ChartEdits.docx) so the exports match the marketing/website/PDF editing process. Body text = Futura PT (Book weight is the regular face; b="0"); titles use b="1" (Futura PT Bold/Heavy). ⚠️ If a machine that OPENS/edits these workbooks lacks Futura PT installed, Excel silently falls back to the theme font — keep Futura PT installed on every editor's machine, or flip this back to `Open Sans` (the Excel-safe universal face) here (one value, no code change).
_series_note: Report CHART series order (marketing-review decision, 8/2026 — supersedes the prior tertiary-order seeding): NM Blue (003DA5), Sky (62B5E5), Blue 85 (265AB2), Steel (9EA9B7), Slate (6A748C), THEN the tertiary ramp (Aquamarine, Peridot, Amethyst, Tourmaline, Topaz, Morganite) for the 6th+ series only. Report charts stay in the blue/neutral family; tertiary hues (peridot/amethyst/etc.) remain sanctioned for INFOGRAPHIC / tile use per the 2024 guide but are NOT the primary series colors on report charts. This decision is recorded here so it is not re-litigated from the guide text (which lists tertiaries at slot 4). Primary blues dominate; use slot N for series N.
_text_note: Chart TITLE = Sky 62B5E5, not-bold, ALL CAPS (marketing ChartEdits 2026-08-12). Chart axis/category labels = Slate 6A748C (marketing ChartEdits 2026-08-12; supersedes the prior Rich Black 191919). Charcoal (3D4A54) stays for worksheet body cells per Briggs §2. Callout numbers: one color per chart, NM Blue default (use Sky 62B5E5 where the series itself is NM Blue, for contrast). Superscript $/+ and the '$5B+' convention apply to the report's KPI tiles, NOT Excel chart data labels (n/a for dLbls).
_sizes_note: Font sizes in OOXML hundredths-of-a-point (1200 = 12pt). Per marketing feedback (ChartEdits 2026-08-12): chart TITLE 12pt Futura PT NOT-bold, ALL CAPS, Sky 62B5E5 (rendered via chartTitleXml with b="0" + toUpperCase); chart-AREA default text (`chartArea`) 8pt Futura PT Book (the whole-chart Format-Chart-Area font); BOTH axis labels (`axisLabel`, x/category + y/value tick labels) 7pt, color Slate 6A748C. Change any here (no code change).

chartSize._note: Fixed chart-object (Chart Area) size in inches per marketing feedback (2026-08 ChartEdits.docx): non-donut charts 4.25"H × 10.00"W; donut charts 4.25" × 4.25" square. Emitted as an explicit-size oneCellAnchor in cm-native-chart-injector.js (1 inch = 914400 EMU). NOTE: the same feedback doc also listed 'entire chart Size: H 3.55" × W 10.12"'; that conflicts with the 4.25×10.00 'Chart area size' line, so the explicit 'Chart area size' values were taken as authoritative. To use the 3.55×10.12 values instead, edit heightIn/widthIn here.

_banned_note: Retired off-brand accents/grays. Slate #6A748C is intentionally NOT banned (it is the on-brand axis/legend neutral).
